description_en: Queries the details of a specified IPv6 gateway, such as the region, VPC, running status, and billing method
description_zh: 调用DescribeIpv6GatewayAttribute接口查询指定IPv6网关所在地域，所属VPC，运行状态，计费方式等详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ipv6-gateway-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-gateway-id ipv6gw-hp3y0l3ln89j8cdvf0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeIpv6GatewayAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPv6网关的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 gateway to query
parameters.name: ipv6_gateway_id

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the IPv6 gateway. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.

FinancialLocked: financial lock.

SecurityLocked: security lock
BusinessStatus.description_zh:
IPv6网关的状态，取值：

Normal：正常。

FinancialLocked：欠费锁定。

SecurityLocked：安全锁定

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the IPv6 gateway was created

Description.description_en: The description of the IPv6 gateway

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the IPv6 gateway

GatewayRouteTableId.description_en:
The ID of the gateway route table associated with the IPv6 gateway.


This parameter is displayed only for IPv6 gateways that are associated with a gateway route table
GatewayRouteTableId.description_zh:
IPv6网关绑定的网关路由表ID。


仅绑定了网关路由表的IPv6网关显示此参数

InstanceChargeType.description_en: The billing method of the IPv6 gateway

Ipv6GatewayId.description_en: The instance ID of the IPv6 gateway

Name.description_en: The name of the IPv6 gateway

OwnerId.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the IPv6 gateway owner.

<notice>This value is of the Long type. Precision loss may occur in certain programming languages. Use this value with caution.></notice>
OwnerId.description_zh:
IPv6网关所属的阿里云账号ID。

<notice>该值为 Long 类型，在某些语言中可能存在精度丢失的风险，请小心使用。></notice>

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway

Status.description_en:
The status of the IPv6 gateway. Valid values:

Pending: being configured.

Available: active
Status.description_zh:
IPv6网关的状态。取值：

Pending：配置中。

Available：可用

Key.description_en:
The tag key. A maximum of 20 tag keys are supported. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Key.description_zh:
标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`

Value.description_en:
The tag value. A maximum of 20 tag values are supported. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Value.description_zh:
标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。

一个标签值最多支持128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the IPv6 gateway belongs
